description: List time entries (id, task_id, user_id, project_id, start_time/end_time or date, duration in seconds, description, billed). At least one filter is required. from/to filter by the entry's time interval; running_only=true returns running timers. Paymo: GET /api/entries.

from.description: Interval start (YYYY-MM-DD = start of that day UTC). Requires `to`.

include.description: Related objects to embed (Paymo `include`), comma-separated, e.g. client or tasklists.tasks.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 100, max 500). Paymo has no pagination; results beyond this are truncated.

running_only.description: true = only running timers (no end_time yet).

to.description: Interval end (YYYY-MM-DD = end of that day UTC). Requires `from`.

where.description: Extra raw Paymo filter ANDed onto the typed ones, e.g. `billable=true` or `name like Website`. Operators: = > >= < <= != like, not like, in (a,b), not in (a,b).

name: paymo_list_time_entries
title: List time entries
